Name: Dong's Harvest Moon-Inspired SVE Portraits
Author: dongpingus
Description:
[b][size=5]I don't see myself updating this in the near future, so please don't count on it. If you use mods like SVE and others and want a similar aesthetic, I highly recommend checking out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu[/url]'s portraits.[/size]

Made for SVE version 1.13.5 and above.
[/b]This mod was made to be used in conjunction with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7443]my previous portrait mod for the base game[/url].
[u][i]Make sure you have SVE and all of its requirements installed.[/i][/u][b]
Install Instructions:
[/b]1. (Optional) Make a backup of the portraits included in the original [CP] Stardew Valley Expanded and [TMX] Stardew Valley Expanded.[b]
[/b]2. Open [CP] Dong's HM-inspired SVE Portraits.7z, drag both [CP] Stardew Valley Expanded and [TMX] Stardew Valley Expanded to where the original folders are. When prompted to replace files, click Yes.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.
[b]NOTE: Updating SVE will override the mod, so simply reapply it again after every update you make.[/b]
